text:
megan: rolling v3.0.1 -> prod done, kicking off post-deploy quickchecks. quick summary: 22/22 unit probes ran, synthetic embed route shows a high tail on two hosts. no 5xxs but p99 elevated. tagging oncall.
deploy-bot: release v3.0.1 deployed by megan to prod. postdeploy quickcheck: OK=21, WARN=1. link: https://deploys.internal/release/3.0.1 :rocket:
sre-bot: alert: synth-embed-p99 > 800ms (duration 00:00:45). affected: infer-04, infer-07. memory-alloc spikes observed on infer-07.
dave: oncall. checking dashboards, cpu and mem look fine except that infer-07 has intermittent allocation churn. any recent infra changes on those hosts?
megan: no infra changes in this release. the model variant is the new q4_0_small variant. can run a quick prefill + sample load on the two hosts. plan suggestion: 1) run chunked kv-prefill to warm tokenizer+kv 2) shift 15% traffic off those two hosts for 6m 3) rerun the synth probe. if p99 stays >900 or errors appear -> pin to q4_0_medium (previous variant) and open rollback window.
dave: agree with cautious approach. initiating prefill. prefill job scheduled:```yaml
job: kv-prefill-chunked
targets: [infer-04,infer-07]
chunks: 5
rate_per_host: 150rps
duration_per_chunk: 45s
```
deploy-bot: routing policy update: moved 15% of embed traffic off infer-04,infer-07 at 14:12 UTC. prefill job started.
sre-bot: prefill progress: chunk 1/5 complete. observed steady token cache warmup, reduce in first-byte times.
megan: re-running synth probe after chunk 3: p50 110ms p95 220ms p99 430ms errors 0/1000. seems improved but p99 still slightly high compared to baseline.
dave: continuing to watch. letting prefill finish all chunks and keep partial drain for 6m. if we see regression in next 10m we'll trigger pin.
sre-bot: prefill complete. final probe run: p99 210ms errors 0/1000. metrics show allocation churn stopped on infer-07.
megan: excellent. updating release notes: "postdeploy: performed chunked kv-prefill on infer-04/infer-07 after transient p99 inflation; stabilized without rollback; watch window 45m."
dave: leaving monitoring open for 45m. if any unexplained flapping occurs we'll pin to q4_0_medium and follow rollback runbook.
deploy-bot: monitoring entry created for release:v3.0.1 - watch:45m - actions:[prefill+partial-reroute, pin-to-previous-if-regress]. :white_check_mark:
